quarterly_data.signal: Corning's 10-K states capital expenditures were $1.3 billion, $1.0 billion and $1.4 billion in 2025, 2024 and 2023. quarterly_data.signal: As of December 31, 2025 and 2024, Corning had customer deposits of approximately $1.5 billion and $1.1 billion. Most of these deposits were non-refundable and allowed customers to secure rights to products produced by Corning under long-term supply agreements, generally over a period of up to 10 years; revenue is recognized and the deposit liability reduced as products are delivered.
